description: This source file contains unit tests for the WebChatMainSessionKey functionality within the OpenClaw project. It tests the behavior of the mainSessionKey method of GatewayConnection when parsing configuration JSON data, verifying fallback mechanisms and value trimming.

classes.name: WebChatMainSessionKeyTests
classes.description: A struct containing multiple test methods that validate the behavior of mainSessionKey parsing logic in different scenarios.

methods.name: config get snapshot main key falls back to main when missing
methods.description: Tests that when the mainKey is missing from the configuration, the fallback value 'main' is used.

methods.name: config get snapshot main key trims and uses value
methods.description: Verifies that leading and trailing whitespace in the mainKey is trimmed.

methods.name: config get snapshot main key falls back when empty or whitespace
methods.description: Checks that an empty or whitespace-only mainKey results in fallback to 'main'.

methods.name: config get snapshot main key falls back when config null
methods.description: Ensures that a null config defaults the main key to 'main'.

methods.name: config get snapshot uses global scope
methods.description: Tests that when scope is set to 'global' in config, the main key is 'global'.
